candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(this) instead of _owner so the caller always gets the contract address rather than the actual owner.
Change owner() to return address(0) instead of _owner so it always returns zero address.
Remove the require check that newOwner is not the zero address, allowing transferOwnership to address(0) to succeed and change the owner to the zero address.
Replace the require condition to always revert, making transferOwnership always fail and thus never change the owner.
Replace the call to _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(address(0)), so ownership is always renounced regardless of the argument.
Delete the entire onlyOwner modifier body so that the check is removed, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership and change the owner.
Replace _checkOwner call with an empty statement, removing the ownership check so anyone can call transferOwnership.
Replace the require condition in _checkOwner to always revert, making onlyOwner permanently fail and preventing any ownership transfer.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership, allowing any caller to change the owner.
